lines.zh: 我四条小短腿踩着落叶走。
lines.en: My four short legs patter over the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 尾巴竖着，像一根小旗杆。
lines.en: My tail stands up like a little flagpole.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的靴子走了半圈。
lines.en: I walk half a circle around your boot.
Wings folded, I walk steadier.

lines.zh: 地上有个坑，我跳过去了。
lines.en: There's a dip in the ground; I hop over it.
I walk slowly so you don't lose me.

lines.zh: 脚爪抓着石阶，一格一格。
lines.en: My claws grip the stone steps, one at a time.

lines.zh: 我从草丛里钻出来，沾了一头草。
lines.en: I push out of the grass with my head full of it.
I walk in your shadow; it's cooler.
I watch the ground more carefully than you do.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，先看看前面。
lines.en: I go step by step, checking ahead first.

lines.zh: 背上的鳞片跟着步子抖。
lines.en: The scales on my back shift with each step.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，把尾巴绕到前面。
lines.en: I crouch and curl my tail around to the front.
I groom my chin with a claw.
An insect calls in the distance, and I listen.
My snout has a smudge of ash on it.

lines.zh: 这地方有点冷，我贴近火。
lines.en: It's a bit cold here, so I edge toward the fire.
I used to be an egg — believe it?

lines.zh: 我在营火上被烤了十分钟。
lines.en: I sat on a campfire for ten minutes.
I chase my own tail in a circle.

lines.zh: 我试着吓一只鸡，失败了。
lines.en: I tried to frighten a chicken and failed.
A chirp comes out of my throat.
I look up at the tree for a long while.

lines.zh: 太阳移动了一点，我也挪了挪。
lines.en: The sun shifted, so I shifted too.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔自己翅膀的边缘。
lines.en: I lick the edge of my wing.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我数自己的鳞。
lines.en: In the quiet I count my own scales.
You're a little shorter than the doorway.
I look up, and my neck complains.
Will you put me on your shoulder?
Is there meat in your hand?
I sniff your fingers.

lines.zh: 这一身鳞是第四种纹样。
lines.en: These scales wear the fourth pattern.
I tilt my head so one eye can see you.
A ring of keys hangs at your belt.
Are you going far away?
I'll follow you; don't leave me behind.

lines.zh: 我展开翅膀，只展开一点。
lines.en: I spread my wings, only a little.
When I call, my voice is very high.
Crouch down and I can look you level.

lines.zh: 你脚下那格是岩浆，小心。
lines.en: The block under you is lava — careful.
I look into your eyes, and keep looking.
I'm not noisy; I'm only watching.

lines.zh: 你的影子把我的尾巴盖住了。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my tail.
Are we on the same side?

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我脸上有东西？
lines.en: What are you laughing at? Is there something on my face?
I rub against your ankle.
My wings haven't fully opened yet.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绕过来，包住自己。
lines.en: I curl my tail around and wrap myself in it.

lines.zh: 我这条小龙，鳞片才长齐。
lines.en: A small dragon whose scales just filled in.
I retreat behind your feet.
The scales on my back are scuffed.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，只有尾巴还翘着。
lines.en: I curl up with only my tail sticking out.
My wing is crooked.
I push myself upright.
I won't cry; dragons don't cry.
I lie down for a moment.
Raw rabbit — I smell it.
Raw chicken works too; I'm not fussy.
I stand on tiptoe and still can't reach.
A little lower — just a little.
The meat smells so good I keep licking my lips.
I bite accurately.
Will I get fire resistance after this?

lines.zh: 岩浆里泡了十分钟，我才醒。
lines.en: Ten minutes in magma before I woke.
Any raw rabbit left in your hand?
I jump and snatch it.
I pull my tail in and dodge.
I bounce off your leg.
I'm too small; you can't see me.
One bump and my head spins.
I roll over at your feet.
Your shoe is taller than I am.
I squeeze past you.
Your boot tip touched my wing.
I bent a wing slightly.
We both stopped.

lines.zh: 另一只小龙从树上下来。
lines.en: Another little dragon comes down from the tree.
We touch nose to nose.
I circle her nearly half way.
Her scales shift color slowly.
We're young; let's sort out the nest first.
I lay my wing over her back.
We lie side by side by the fire.
In time, there will be eggs.

lines.zh: 我把她翅膀上的灰吹掉。
lines.en: I blow the dust off her wings.
We keep the same fire.
I snatch the meat and run.
I bite down and dig in with four claws.
I hug it with both front claws.
My teeth are too small to pierce it.
I dropped it once and picked it back up.
I stuff it into a crack in the rock.
I'll play with the shiny one first.
Carrying it, I can't go fast.
Holding it, I can't lift my head.
I'll hide it for later.
Something big is moving over there.
I raise my ears first.
Is this an enemy? I think so.
I lower my head, ready to charge.
Its foot is right in front of me.
I've locked on, small as I am.
I can see its neck.
My claws grip the ground.
I'll show what I can do this time.
Step back; let me try.
My throat is starting to heat.
I'm ready — truly.
It hasn't noticed me.
I circle in past its feet.
That patch is a weak spot, right?
I want to win once in front of you.
I run low along the ground, silent.
I bite its heel.
It kicks, and I'm thrown off.
I climb back again.
I open my mouth, and my throat glows.

lines.zh: 翅膀这么小，得先看清再动。
lines.en: Wings this small need a clear look first.
I go around behind it.
I need to get behind it first.
I circle its feet.
It's looking at me, so I freeze.
My wings are pressed low.
I need to find a gap.
That bite has to land true.
My heartbeat is frighteningly fast.
I climb its leg.
It turned and I nearly fell.
I've got hold of it.
The fire is already in my mouth.
My small flame singes its fur.

lines.zh: 火焰打在它腿上，散开了。
lines.en: The flame hits its leg and scatters.
I clamp its hide and hold.
My claws rake three lines.
I ram my head into its knee.

lines.zh: 这一下我使了全身的劲。
lines.en: I put my whole body into that.
The fire was small; I breathe again.
I'm knocked away and roll twice.
It's hurt — I saw it.
I retreat to your feet.
My throat is dry.
That bite landed on armor.
I leap up again.
The flame makes my shadow huge.
I'm panting, and still standing.
Did I do all right?
Ten minutes soaking in lava.

lines.zh: 火还在烧，我就在火里出生。
lines.en: The fire still burns; I was born in it.
I shake the shell bits off.

lines.zh: 第一眼看的是你的靴子。
lines.en: The first thing I see is your boot.
This place is enormous.

lines.zh: 试着张开翅膀，还不太稳。
lines.en: Trying to spread my wings, still unsteady.

lines.zh: 我摔了一下，又站起来了。
lines.en: I fall once and get back up.
I smell grass and stone.
I was lifted out of a chest.

lines.zh: 我打了第一个嗝，有火星。
lines.en: My first burp came out with sparks.

lines.zh: 你是我见到的第一个人。
lines.en: You're the first person I've seen.
I'll just follow you, then.
I poke half my head out of the shell.
I shuffle into your shadow.
I think I'm hungry.
I turn to look for my tail.

lines.zh: 这个世界的风比蛋里大。
lines.en: The wind out here is bigger than inside the egg.
Let me shake out my feet first.

lines.zh: 我自己会喷火，却也怕烫。
lines.en: I breathe fire, and I still fear being burned.

lines.zh: 我从桌上掉下来，摔懵了。
lines.en: I fell off the table and I'm dazed.

lines.zh: 水进鼻子了，我拼命扑腾。
lines.en: Water in my nose — I thrash for the surface.
The blast blows me several blocks.

lines.zh: 一根箭比我整个人还长。
lines.en: That arrow is longer than I am.
That light makes my scales prickle.
My belly is flat and I can't walk.

lines.zh: 雷声一响，我躲进你怀里。
lines.en: At the thunderclap I hide against you.

lines.zh: 我什么都抓不住，一直往下。
lines.en: I can't catch hold of anything; I keep falling.
